dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Significant geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the posterior region, forming a tapered teardrop profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical structural deviations or localized bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey median pixel intensity observed across the dorsal surface, characteristic of a sub-adult or pigmented adult.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and low-contrast transitions between minor tonal variations across the skin surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast white linear streak is visible on the posterior dorsal axis, oriented longitudinally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single vertical white scar or mark visible on the lower half of the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Anteriorly positioned dark circular pixel cluster corresponding to the blowhole aperture.
